title: Vegetable Biryani
subtitle: Indian rice with vegetables
description: Fragrant basmati rice layered with a spiced vegetable and rose-water yoghurt mixture, steamed together and served with fried onion.

steps.text: Rinse the rice, soak in water for 30 minutes and drain.
Cook the rice in plenty of boiling salted water (as for pasta) until 90% cooked, about 12 minutes over high heat. Drain well.
Heat a frying pan with the oil or ghee and fry the chopped onions for about 6 minutes until golden. Add the cardamom, cloves, cinnamon, bay leaf and cumin seeds and fry for 30-40 seconds more.

Add the garlic and ginger paste, green beans cut into 1-2 cm pieces, diced carrot and peas, and season with salt. Add 1/4 cup water, cover and cook for 5 minutes until the vegetables soften slightly. Turn off the heat.
Mix the yoghurt with the rosewater and add to the pan with the vegetables. Up to this point it can be prepared a few hours ahead.

Assemble: spread half the rice on the bottom of a pot, arrange the vegetable mixture on top and cover with the remaining rice. Sprinkle with garam masala and chopped mint or mint leaves, cover and cook over low heat for 5 minutes. Turn off the heat, leave for 5 more minutes without lifting the lid and serve with fried onion.
